title: durio macrophyllus
intro: Durio macrophyllus, commonly known as the Borneo jackfruit tree, is a species of plant in the family Sapindaceae. It is known for its edible fruits and medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Durio macrophyllus include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, and may be used to treat conditions like fever, cough, and skin diseases.
